text: As the number of individuals required to certify compliance under CIAs grows, so does the potential for false certifications and the corresponding liability, including False Claims Act and criminal false statement exposure.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Elizabeth R. Malay, The Role of Corporate Integrity Agreements in the Expansion of Fiduciary Duties (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2317580

isBasedOn.name: The Role of Corporate Integrity Agreements in the Expansion of Fiduciary Duties

abstract: With the increased number of individuals certifying compliance with CIA provisions, the potential for false certifications and corresponding liability intensifies.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: expanded certification requirements going beyond the chief compliance officer
